features.name: global_energy_norm
features.description: Clipped root-mean-square magnitude across all 51 numeric descriptors; summarizes how far the row is from the centered training-fold scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives a linear SVM a smooth radial severity coordinate for rows with many unusually large descriptor values.

features.name: early_block_mean_level
features.description: Clipped average of the first descriptor block V1 through V5, using their already centered numeric scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a low-variance approximate projection of the first block, useful when multiple small shifts jointly define a margin.

features.name: early_block_shape_contrast
features.description: Clipped contrast between upper-index members V3-V5 and lower-index members V1-V2 within the first descriptor block.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures shape differences within the first block that a raw average would miss while remaining linear after construction.

features.name: mirrored_channel_level
features.description: Clipped average of V14 and V32, two channels with matching training-fold summary statistics; reduces duplicate-channel noise while preserving direction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Collapses two mirrored channels into one stable coordinate, reducing redundant noise for margin fitting.

features.name: tail_spike_log_density
features.description: Average log-compressed above-zero activation across highly right-skewed descriptor channels.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses rare high spikes so a linear SVM can use heavy-tail evidence without being dominated by one extreme channel.
features.formula: np.clip((np.log1p(np.maximum(V8, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V9, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V12, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V13, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V15, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V17, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V21, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V22, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V28, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V29, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V42, 0.0))) / 11.0, 0.0, 4.0)

features.name: mid_band_upper_pressure
features.description: Mean clipped upper-side magnitude over V18-V31, capturing how strongly the middle descriptor band exceeds zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a smooth severity coordinate for high middle-band excursions.
features.formula: np.clip((np.maximum(V18, 0.0) + np.maximum(V19, 0.0) + np.maximum(V20, 0.0) + np.maximum(V21, 0.0) + np.maximum(V22, 0.0) + np.maximum(V23, 0.0) + np.maximum(V24, 0.0) + np.maximum(V25, 0.0) + np.maximum(V26, 0.0) + np.maximum(V27, 0.0) + np.maximum(V28, 0.0) + np.maximum(V29, 0.0) + np.maximum(V30, 0.0) + np.maximum(V31, 0.0)) / 14.0, 0.0, 6.0)

features.name: mid_band_lower_pressure
features.description: Mean clipped lower-side magnitude over V18-V31, capturing how strongly the middle descriptor band falls below zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a complementary severity coordinate for low middle-band excursions.
features.formula: np.clip((np.maximum(-V18, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V19, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V20, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V21, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V22, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V23, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V24, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V25, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V26, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V27, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V28, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V29, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V30, 0.0) + np.maximum(-V31, 0.0)) / 14.0, 0.0, 4.0)

features.name: late_count_log_pressure
features.description: Average log-compressed above-zero activation for the late count-like descriptor block V33-V43.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns sparse late-block bursts into a bounded continuous score suitable for linear weighting.
features.formula: np.clip((np.log1p(np.maximum(V33, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V34, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V35, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V36, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V37, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V38, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V39, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V40, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V41, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V42, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V43, 0.0))) / 11.0, 0.0, 4.0)

features.name: tail_to_baseline_magnitude_ratio
features.description: Clipped ratio between right-skew spike activity and baseline magnitude in V1-V7.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights rows where tail activity is large relative to baseline magnitude, adding scale-aware contrast.
features.formula: np.clip((1.0 + np.log1p(np.maximum(V8, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V9, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V12, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V13, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V15, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V17, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V21, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V22, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V28, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V29, 0.0)) + np.log1p(np.maximum(V42, 0.0))) / (1.0 + np.abs(V1) + np.abs(V2) + np.abs(V3) + np.abs(V4) + np.abs(V5) + np.abs(V6) + np.abs(V7)), 0.0, 8.0)

features.name: final_directional_signature
features.description: Signed average contrast over V44-V51 that rewards V44,V46,V47,V48,V49,V50 and subtracts V45,V51.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a signed projection over the final block, helping a linear margin exploit consistent directionality.

features.name: proof_search_compactness_judgment
features.description: Reviewer or rules-engine score from 0 to 1 estimating whether the row describes a compact proof-search instance, using only the row's V-column pattern and training-fold scaling metadata.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded expert summary that a linear SVM can combine with numeric composites when descriptor interactions are hard to express compactly.

features.name: strategy_pattern_coherence_judgment
features.description: Reviewer or rules-engine score from 0 to 1 for how internally coherent the descriptor blocks appear as a theorem-proving strategy signature, based only on the row's V-column pattern.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a semantic consistency axis that may align recurring theorem-proving patterns with a simple linear margin.
